components.name: Primary Action Pill
components.description: Tactile porcelain capsule button for key page actions and navigation triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fafafa; color: #111111; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 8px 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 2px 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), -4px -4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.95); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 300ms ease, box-shadow 300ms ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(233,30,140,0.15), 12px 14px 28px rgba(233,30,140,0.12), 4px 6px 10px rgba(233,30,140,0.08), -6px -6px 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { ring: 2px solid #e91e8c; outline: 2px solid #e91e8c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compact Card Action
components.description: Compact tactile tile button for document card actions (View, Download).
components.css: .ds-btn-compact { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #fafafa; color: #111111; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 4px 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), -2px -2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.95); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-compact:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(233,30,140,0.15), 6px 8px 14px rgba(233,30,140,0.12), -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.98); } .ds-btn-compact:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e91e8c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Primary raised content container featuring an inner recessed thumbnail well.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #fafafa; border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 8px 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 2px 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), -4px -4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.95); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; } .ds-card-well { width: 100%; height: 90px; background: #fdfdfd; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.03); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), inset 3px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), inset -3px -3px 8px rgba(255,255,255,0.95); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-badge { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #e91e8c; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #6b7280; margin: 0; }

components.name: Dropdown Trigger
components.description: Accessible custom select trigger with arrow traversal and ARIA listbox support.
components.css: .ds-dropdown-trigger { width: 100%; height: 48px; background: #fafafa; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 8px 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), -4px -4px 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.95); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-dropdown-trigger:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(233,30,140,0.15), 10px 12px 24px rgba(233,30,140,0.10), -5px -5px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.98); } .ds-dropdown-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e91e8c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dropdown-label { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #111111; }

narrative.overview:
Horizon is designed as a tranquil, tangible academic environment engineered for sustained study without cognitive fatigue. Unlike standard modern software interfaces dominated by flat, sterile grey planes or loud commercial gamification, Horizon crafts a physical desk feeling. Interactive surfaces possess soft tangible mass, tactile recessed wells hold study materials, and delicate hairline perimeter traces ground each element in physical space.

The aesthetic blends editorial typographic prestige with refined tactile neumorphism. Academic serif headlines evoke library volumes and textbook clarity, while cushioned pill controls and smooth dual-cast shadows provide tactile confidence. The palette is calm and light-absorbing, allowing secondary school students to focus on dense NCERT/CBSE chapter texts and past-year exam questions for hours without visual strain.
keyCharacteristics: Physical dual-direction neumorphism with balanced raised and recessed planes.
Editorial typographic pairing blending Instrument Serif prestige with Playfair Display structural titles and Roboto functional clarity.
Low-contrast, glare-free paper tones with rare, high-intent magenta accents.
Strict keyboard accessibility with dedicated focus-visible ring precision.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Doctrine
rules.body: Editorial Magenta (#e91e8c) is strictly restricted to ≤10% of any given viewport. Its power comes from restraint; when everything calls for attention, nothing receives it. It is reserved for keyboard focus rings, active filters, and primary conversion triggers.

rules.name: The Dual-Trace Doctrine
rules.body: Every raised card and button must feature an outer boundary trace (rgba(0,0,0,0.15)) coupled with an opposing inner highlight trace (rgba(255,255,255,0.95)). Physical surfaces never end abruptly in a CSS border without lighting cues.

rules.name: The Editorial Em Rule
rules.body: Italicized emphasis spans (<em>) in display headings use the Editorial Magenta gradient (linear-gradient(to bottom right, #E91E8C, #C2185B, #8B0A50)) with -webkit-background-clip: text and generous right padding (0.15em) to prevent italic glyph clipping.

rules.name: The Inset Companion Rule
rules.body: Every major raised card (.neu-card) must contain an internal recessed child container or well (.neu-recessed) with a 4px inset buffer to create physical depth equilibrium.

dos: Do wrap all interactive custom buttons and links with focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#E91E8C] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 rather than generic focus:ring.
Do maintain the 10% maximum surface limit on Editorial Magenta accents to keep student focus centered on reading material.
Do pair raised containers with internal recessed wells to preserve the physical desk metaphor.
Do provide explicit WAI-ARIA roles, attributes (role="listbox", role="slider", role="dialog"), and aria-hidden="true" on decorative SVG icons.
Do use Instrument Serif strictly for display heroes and section highlights, relying on Playfair Display for structural titles.
donts: Don't use solid pure-black #000000 borders or harsh flat box-shadows.
Don't add promotional banners, gamified point popups, countdown timers, or confetti animations to educational surfaces.
Don't use generic cold blue SaaS accents; Horizon's identity is grounded in warm paper neutrals and Editorial Magenta.
Don't trigger focus rings on pointer/mouse clicks; always isolate keyboard focus with :focus-visible.
Don't apply decorative icons without aria-hidden="true" or icon-only buttons without aria-label and matching title.
